*New Community Introduces Five Home Designs with Pricing in the Mid-$200,000s*


ROME, Ga.


, Aug. 21, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Lennar, one of the nation's leading homebuilders, today announced the Grand Opening of Prentis Branch, a new community of single-family homes in scenic and historic Rome, Georgia. Bringing new construction at attainable price points to a town known for a sophisticated and friendly small-town lifestyle, Prentis Branch offers modern floorplans and convenient access to downtown Rome, highly rated schools and thousands of acres of open space.


"Prentis Branch gives homebuyers the rare combination of new construction close to the shopping, and dining in downtown Rome, highly regarded schools and some of Northwest Georgia's best outdoor recreation," said Scott Withington, Division President of Lennar's Atlanta Division. "We're proud to welcome our first homeowners to a smart, sustainable community in a city consistently recognized as a Bee City USA and a Tree City USA for its environmental stewardship."


Prentis Branch features five exclusive Lennar Home designs: Beckman, Coleman, Hansom, Charleston and Pruitt. All showcase open-concept floorplans, modern kitchens and flexible living spaces across two-story and ranch-style layouts. Homes in Prentis Branch range from 1,274 to 2,023 square feet with three to four bedrooms and two to three-and-a-half bathrooms. Every home comes with Lennar's signature[Everything's Included®](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4757512-1&h=1640537382&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4727920-1%26h%3D1244429014%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fedge.prnewswire.com%252Fc%252Flink%252F%253Ft%253D0%2526l%253Den%2526o%253D4634251-1%2526h%253D1763803708%2526u%253Dhttps%25253A%25252F%25252Fc212.net%25252Fc%25252Flink%25252F%25253Ft%25253D0%252526l%25253Den%252526o%25253D4083698-1%252526h%25253D1485268572%252526u%25253Dhttps%2525253A%2525252F%2525252Fwww.lennar.com%2525252Fproductsandservices%2525252Feverythings-included%252526a%25253DEverything%25252527s%25252BIncluded%252525C2%252525AE%2526a%253DEverything%252527s%252BIncluded%2525C2%2525AE%26a%3DEverything%2527s%2BIncluded%25C2%25AE&a=Everything%27s+Included%C2%AE) promise, where for Prentis Branch homes, smart home features come standard and included in the price of the home. Pricing starts in the mid-$200,000s.


Prentis Branch homeowners will enjoy four community parks, ideal for outdoor recreation, gathering, and unwinding close to home. The community boasts convenient access to the shopping, dining and entertainment options downtown Rome and Riverbend Shopping Center have to offer, in addition to outdoor recreation destinations like Heritage Park, Riverview Sports Complex and the Rome Tennis Center. Families living in the community can also benefit from access to the Floyd County School District, recognized for its strong academic programs, Advanced Placement coursework and dual enrollment opportunities.


For more information on Prentis Branch, call (470) 945-7935 or visit the[community website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4757512-1&h=251524387&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2Fnew-homes%2Fgeorgia%2Fatlanta%2Frome%2Fprentis-branch&a=community+website) .


**About Lennar Corporation**
Lennar Corporation, founded in 1954, is one of the nation's leading builders of quality homes for all generations. Lennar builds affordable, move-up and active adult homes primarily under the Lennar brand name. Lennar's Financial Services segment provides mortgage financing, title and closing services primarily for buyers of Lennar's homes and, through LMF Commercial, originates mortgage loans secured primarily by commercial real estate properties throughout the United States. Lennar's Multifamily segment is a nationwide developer of high-quality multifamily rental properties. LENX drives Lennar's technology, innovation and strategic investments.
